article.headline: Manhattan beats Presbyterian 86-81 in OT
article.description: — Will Sydnor, Devin Dinkins and Jaden Winston scored 18 points apiece to help Manhattan defeat Presbyterian 86-81 in overtime on Saturday.
article.story: CLINTON, S.C. -- — Will Sydnor, Devin Dinkins and Jaden Winston scored 18 points apiece to help Manhattan defeat Presbyterian 86-81 in overtime on Saturday. Sydnor added eight rebounds and three blocks for the Jaspers (6-5). Winston added six rebounds. Dinkins shot 4 of 8 from the field, including 2 for 4 from 3-point range, and went 8 for 8 from the line for his 18 points. Carl Parrish finished with 23 points and nine rebounds for the Blue Hose (7-7). Kory Mincy added 18 points, seven assists and two steals for Presbyterian. Jamahri Harvey also put up 13 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
